'''Jugg''' is a [[Effects|Potion Effect]] introduced by the SRP Mod. A dislodgement-bound effect that triggers on death. Depending on active [[Dislodgment]] codes, nearby parasites may be healed, nearby non-parasites may be damaged, and nearby players may suffer exhaustion. Certain deaths also apply a Jugg surge to the killer for a short time, with strength tied to stored dislocation values.
